camel_example: aliyun esa UpdateEdgeContainerAppResourceReserve --region cn-hangzhou --Forever true --AppId 'app-880688675783790000' --Enable true --DurationTime '2006-01-02T15:04:05Z' --ReserveSet '[{"Isp":"cmcc","Region":"huazhong","Replicas":1}]'
description_en: Updates the resource reservation configuration of an edge container application
description_zh: 更新边缘容器资源预留配置
kebab_example: aliyun esa update-edge-container-app-resource-reserve --enable true --forever true --duration-time 2006-01-02T15:04:05Z --reserve-set Isp=cmcc Region=huazhong Replicas=1 --app-id app-880688675783790000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateEdgeContainerAppResourceReserve

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable resource reservation
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to permanently enable reservation. Once enabled, you cannot set a reservation end time
parameters.help_zh: 是否永久开启预留，一旦开启，不允许设置预留截止时间
parameters.name: forever

parameters.help_en: The reservation end time. This parameter uses UTC time. To convert from UTC+8, add 8 hours. For example, if the current time is 2006-01-02 06:04:05 in UTC+8, enter "2006-01-02T14:04:05Z"
parameters.help_zh: 预留截止时间，该接口输入为UTC时间，输入北京时间需+8小时，例如当前为不北京时间 2006-01-02 06:04:05 , 则需要输入"2006-01-02T14:04:05Z"
parameters.name: duration_time

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) operation to obtain the application ID.
<notice>The AppId format is the app- prefix followed by a numeric suffix, with a total length of 20 to 64 characters (example: app-8806886*83794688). Call ListEdgeContainerApps to obtain an existing AppId, or call CreateEdgeContainerApp to create an application first.</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~)接口获取应用ID。
<notice>AppId 格式为 app- 前缀后接纯数字后缀，总长度 20 至 64 字符（示例：app-8806886*83794688）。可调用 ListEdgeContainerApps 获取已有 AppId，或先调用 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建应用。</notice>
parameters.name: app_id
